Time of day: dusk — blue hour, lights coming on.

Outfit: an opaque raspberry swim ensemble consisting of a supportive origami-pleated folded bandeau with a deep central notch and sculpted bubble-hem swim shorts, both fully lined and securely fitted; a narrow matching underbust band supports the top. Each hand has only that job.
Composition: a three-quarter seated view from knees upward, face fully visible and turned gently toward the camera, camera at her eye height, the suspended daybed sweeping diagonally across the image and the distant lights low behind her.
